notes.title: Patch 1.9.0 - Update beyond human imagination!
notes.content:
With time, Blockbuster Inc. becomes a better game with a wider variety of mechanics and enhancements - designed to keep you satisfied and coming back for more. Today's major patch is the showcase of our recent hard work, and we hope it meets your expectations. We're still constantly working on the game, so even more things to come! [b]Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Patch 1.9.0[/b]! 🎉

Especially for this occasion, we’ve prepared a [b]video showcasing the changes[/b] over the past few months! 
✔️ customizable backgrounds 
✔️ up to 15 actors on scene 
✔️ regency and superhero updates 
✔️ subtitle system 
✔️ new lightning options  

[previewyoutube=Jvm0P6YyZXw;full][/previewyoutube]

Let’s not forget that this week we’re celebrating [b]Halloween[/b]! 🎃👻🍬 To mark the occasion, you’ll find a new [b]Ghostkiller theme, costumes[/b], and [b]set designer objects[/b] in the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/49494bd84865ca928f5c25dd81e4b066dbd59a31.png[/img]

Apart from the cosmetic additions, a lot has changed in the game mechanics too! The full list of changes is below! 

[h2]🎥 New Features & Improvements:[/h2]
[list][*] Facial Expression Controls: New sliders for facial expressions (happiness, anger, surprise) in the Animations tab within Direct Scene.
[/list] [list][*] Lighting Control: A Lights tab in Direct Scene allows you to adjust environmental light color and intensity for better scene ambiance.
[/list] [list][*] Copy Scene Properties: A “Copy to Other Scenes” button in Product Creation lets you transfer scene settings quickly to other scenes.
[/list] [list][*] Employee Search Upgrade: A new “Find More Candidates” button in the Hire menu lets you pay to find more or higher-quality employees.
[/list]

[h2]📅 Gameplay Adjustments:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Quarterly System: Each in-game day now represents a quarter instead of a month (Q1-Q4), with awards held every second year. [/list] [list][*] Added difficulty setting that can be chosen in the new game menu and can be changed anytime in Settings. Available levels: Sandbox, Easy, Normal, Hard. The differences of each level are shown in the difficulty selection menu
[/list] [list][*] Trending Themes: Now, two themes trend each year, boosting product hype when used.
[/list]

[h2]🎬 Rival Studios & Economy:[/h2]
[list][*] Rival Studio AI Improvements: Rivals now make smarter hiring, firing, and product release decisions.[/list] [list][*] Bankruptcy Mechanic: Rival studios can go bankrupt, pausing operations for a year before returning.[/list] [list][*] Shared Consumer Pool: A new, limited sales pool (starting at 1M in 1920) grows over time, creating competition for sales among studios.
[/list] [list][*] There is now a fixed-size shared consumer pool, which means there is a limited amount of sales to be achieved per year and is shared among studios and products. If there are many products being released by many studios at the same time, the people will prefer the ones with the higher hype and quality, leading to reduced sales for the rest of the products. The consumer pool size starts at 1 million sales in 1920 and slowly increases, reaching the limit of 5 million in 2020
[/list]
[h2]🧑‍💼 Employee Management:[/h2]
[list][*]Employees may now become stressed if overworked, and can issue resignation notices if unhappy for extended periods.[/list] [list][*] Employees will now give a resignation notice if they stay unhappy for longer than 3 days. During this time, you can offer them a raise using the Negotiate button to persuade them to stay. If you don't, or if they don't accept your raise offer, they will leave the studio and can't be hired again for one year[/list] [list][*]Firing employees with unpaid salaries may lead to union actions, requiring you to pay owed salaries.[/list] [list][*] You can now use the Negotiate menu anytime to offer a raise to your employees for a happiness bonus and to guarantee they won't quit for some time[/list] [list][*] Employees will now become unhappy if they feel that they are underpaid, in which case you can give them a raise to appease them[/list] [list][*] Employees now have higher salary expectations if they have high skills, long employment record, or worked on many products[/list][list][*] If you fire employees that have unpaid salaries, you will need to pay the owed salaries before hiring them again[/list] [list][*] if you fire too many employees that have unpaid salaries, at some point when you will have enough money to pay them back, their Union will take legal action against you and demand that you pay all the salaries you owe[/list] [list][*] The Hire and Manage Employees windows now use pagination instead of scrollbar and have multiple sorting options
[/list]

[h2]🎙️ New Options & Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Radio Lines: Random radio lines play throughout the day (disable in Settings if needed).
[/list] [list][*] Custom Sound Effects: Import custom sounds in the Video Editor for unique productions.
[/list] [list][*] Bank Loan Payoff Option: Instantly repay bank loans.[/list] [list][*] The Studio Charts now show the number of employees and products of each studio as well as the studio status (active/bankrupt) and the number of bankruptcies so far[/list] [list][*] The tooltip of the happiness bar in Character Sheet now show positive/negative effects with green/red text respectively[/list] [list][*] A warning is now shown if you try to import the same custom-made character twice, but you can ignore the warning and proceed, which simply creates a clone
[/list] [list][*] Extra scenes can now be added only in movies, not in TV shows. This is to prevent a complex bug that caused some scenes in TV shows to be deleted[/list] [list][*] Product sheet now lists all involved employees, not just actors[/list]
[h2]⚙️ Bug Fixes:[/h2]
🟢studio shares now work properly and bring back a portion of the original studio's revenue every quarter. If that studio goes bankrupt, you lose the shares you bought from them. You can sell back the shares of other studios but you can no longer sell your own studio's shares, as this could often cause a disadvantage that was hard to recover from
🟢 filming tasks are now prioritized over education (e.g. previously actors wouldn't go film their scenes if they were in a classroom)
🟢 sorting options sometimes were not working correctly in all types of Charts
🟢 TV show episodes after 1st episode were showing incorrect number of fans and awards
🟢 the set prestige bar in the product score breakdown would always appear half-empty even if the set's prestige was maxed out
🟢 moving the camera downwards by moving the cursor to the viewport bottom was not working in Build Mode

Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/8MXBaT7HTG]Discord[/url]! 
Thank you for everything and have a great Halloween! 🦇

notes.title: Patch 1.8.1 - Select your own, custom set's screen background!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Movie Creators!🎥 How are you enjoying your summer? ☀️ [/h3]
During August, our team took the time off to rest and gather even more power to bring you more and more cool updates, and we are totally back with a brand, new content! 🎉

We are pretty sure that the following update will bring even more fun, as we decided to give you more freedom and the possibility to customize your set in your sole discretion. 👀 

Let's introduce [b]custom set's screen backgrounds[/b]! 🎬
Is there a better way to fulfill oneself as a film director than deciding how a particular scene will look? 
Now it's possible with our new customization option. 💥
You are able to select one of [b]many backgrounds[/b] that were previously prepared by us, but also... [b]you can upload something of your choice[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/d23bb3cc7e4ff0747a59bd8820924047c11ba5d1.gif[/img]

👇 Here's a quick instruction on how to do it! 

[olist]
[*] Build a Screen set
[*] Assign it to the product scene in Product Creation
[*] Open Direct Scene
[*] Go to Screen Visuals tab
[*] Choose a preset or custom photo/video to show ([i]please note, that the photo format should be bmp/jpg/png, and mp4 when it comes to the video[/i]) 
[/olist]

It isn't the only thing we are bringing to you with this update. 
A new [b]House Interior set[/b] is also waiting for you, along with [b]new objects[/b]! 🏠 
Here's a little sneak peek! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/c815ccda12173138772f34cfc51601ecc80c1134.gif[/img]

Check out the list of additional changes below, download the update and let us know how you like it!

🎁 [b]What’s new?[/b]
🟡 new/updated hair and added facial hair in Character Creator
🟡 customizable controls in Settings
🟡 added controls in Camera Movement tab of Direct Scene for changing camera position and motion
🟡 duration of producer/writer work is increased and is proportional to product size

🔧 [b]Bug fixes:[/b]
🟢 fix bug where some fire/fog/rain machines would not produce visible effects in the filmed scene
🟢 fix bug where actors would sometimes appear floating or sinking into the set floor while filming
🟢 fix bug where build mode could be toggled during Awards Ceremony by pressing Tab

[b]If you have any questions or feedback join us on [url=https://discord.gg/8MXBaT7HTG]Discord[/url]! [/b]

notes.title: Update 1.7.16.1 - Regency update
notes.content:
Esteemed lords and ladies of the ton! 🎩💐

Surprise, surprise! [b]Today we deliver our biggest update yet[/b] and with it a chance to find true love in the early 1800s London! Not to mention over [b]a dozen fixes and a heap of additions and quality of life improvements.[/b] Quite a revelation!

To celebrate the season 3 finale of the beloved Bridgerton series we present the[b] new in-game theme for the actors and movie sets: "Regency"[/b] 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/598270a05d2ffed1a7363bbe40a4f99797f86c83.gif[/img]

So grab your mouse and start working on a new gossip-worthy TV or movie production that I am sure Lady Whistledown would approve!

This update is another labor of love fueled by the[b] constant engagement of our most beloved and most supportive playerbase[/b]. Know that [b]you are seen, you are loved, and we could not do it without you![/b] 🫶

Also - just in case you missed it - [b]we have previously dropped a few smaller updates[/b] that addressed some of your most pressing feedback and added more content to the game. Read about them [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1793090/view/4149583904654775080]here[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1793090/view/4149583904669120442]here[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1793090/view/5997186379237176411]here[/url].[/b]

Find the full changelog for the Regency Update below 👇️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/138df41c1017846a500f66bd1446eb9d3d784fda.jpg[/img]

[b]Changelog for the 1.7.16.1 version:[/b]

- new theme "Regency", inspired by Bridgerton, including costumes, set designer objects, and build mode objects
- new visuals for all set equipment cameras/lights/mics of 1950-2000
- optimize thumbnail generation for Build Mode, Set Designer, Set Equipment, which should reduce lag spikes significantly
- add one default filming set per theme to always have available sets for any theme without having to make them in Set Designer
- progressively increased difficulty in achieving high movie score as decades progress
- add sound for notifications, togglable in Settings
- fix windowed mode not always working
- make not-yet-available research grayed out instead of hidden, so you can always see when the next research will arrive
- set default FPS limiter to 60 (configurable in Settings) to avoid GPU overheat
- fix Researchers always working even when they have to attend education
- fix room info & filming set info windows getting auto-closed every time you enter build mode
- fix some actor animations that were looping even though they shouldn't
- limit max fame level of available-for-hire employees to level 1
- research for medium & high quality food is now available from the beginning of the game
- the studio fences and gate get renovated after 1950 and after 1980
- the cinema next to the studio gets renovated after 1980
- company money is now limited to max 999 billion
- company fans, product fans and product ticket sales are now limited to max 999 million
- product hype is now limited to max 9999
- reduce fame increase rate by 50%
- fix filming set's camera resetting to cheapest camera when relocating
- fix overflow when calculating product revenue that caused the revenue to become negative
- fix room type icon not showing above a premade room when it is placed in build mode
- actors in Set Designer can now be placed anywhere even if they clip into objects
- added buttons for deleting files in the open/save file dialog in Set Designer and Import Character menus
- allow getting loans even if company money is below 0
- fix bug in TV show episodes after first episode that showed incorrect scene rating and prevented reshooting scenes
- fix VFX/SFX designer tasks in Product Creation (post-production tab) not being cleared when starting a new product
- fix employee type filter in Hire Employees menu getting reset when hiring an employee
- added decorated versions of premade rooms in Build Mode
- added subcategory buttons in Build Mode for premade rooms (simple/decorated) and filming sets (default/local/steam)
- added decade intro sequence shown when reaching new decade

We are waiting for your feedback [b]on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1793090/discussions/]Steam discussion forum[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/VuCRd7Q8GF]Discord server[/url]![/b]

notes.title: 3... 2... 1... Blockbuster Inc. Is Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]3… 2… 1… Action![/h1]

This is it! [b]After many years full of passion and dedication, we made it to the release day![/b]

Standing here right at the precipe of launching our game, [b]we want to thank each and every one of you for being with us[/b] since the first gameplay reveal. For trying out the first demo, and then helping us tweak the game even further with the free prologue. For sharing all the feedback, all the positive comments and motivation to bring you the best possible experience.

[previewyoutube=htXgBDQl52o;full][/previewyoutube]
As a [b]small team of three core members[/b], we are fully aware of what comes next. The work is not done yet, we will be pushing and striving to fix all the issues you report, and to keep releasing new content that will allow you to create even better, more engaging movies!

[i]''Years of dedication and passion poured into our project has finally led us to the release. We are beyond happy to share our efforts and project with our players but even more excited to see what the future brings for our company and the game itself. [b]We will not stop adding content and improving things any time soon, Blockbuster Inc. still has untapped potential and with the help of our strong community we are more than ready to explore that.[/b] So grab your director's chairs, sit tightly and join us into this brand new adventure of the movie industry. We appreciate you all." - Panos Tzimas, Founder of Super Sly Fox[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/9a51e745075a38f0777cafcd30def9b90d94ea74.png[/img]
We keep a close eye on our Discord server and Steam forum. We read your feedback under influencers content and we closely investigate what journalists have written in their reviews. [b]We are prepared for the days to come![/b] And we couldn't be happier than now when you can finally play and share your precious feedback with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/1fd5d568de829684cf40a7f941ebab34768e3f27.png[/img]
Some time ago, we were awarded multiple NYX Game Awards, and right now we are waiting for our [b]metacritic score to unlock, with 3 reviews over 80%[/b]! But we are not going to slow down. Soon there will be a [b]post-launch development roadmap[/b] released on our socials and here, and we will present our plans for upcoming months. First, we would like to include your initial feedback from the release and adjust this roadmap accordingly to your needs. So stay tuned!

More news is coming, and for now, [b]we wish you a great time with the game.[/b] And don’t forget to write a review!

Now Go! Make Your Dream Movies!
[b]Panos, Alkis, Kostas and Ancient Forge team[/b]

notes.title: NPC creator and 7 new languages in Blockbuster Inc.
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, Camerons’ and Tarantinos’ of gaming!! [/b][/h2]

We are getting closer and closer to the release, so it’s time to show you some new things! 

There is a brand new, cool video for you. Trust us. Watch it. 

[previewyoutube=vP4KgxcpJck;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Create your own Daya Zen in our new characters’ creator![/b][/h2]

With the new feature, you can create the team of professionals, top tier actors, or simply workers you would like to hire immediately! Combine the perfect traits for every job, or pick available workers from the list. You can always try to steal a star signed to... someone's else movie!

Building too much star power early on has its drawbacks! Hiring several five-star actors and dealing with their rental houses can be costly for an up-and-coming studio.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/7b8e9052bad6e1e6491c4dc0092198adbfad1a58.png[/img]
Hiring top-level workers with only the best traits and skills will end your budget sooner than you think.

[b]Don’t say we didn’t warn you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/bc93d5d92a3776f95bc24c3ea4c5d3db8f1b573c.png[/img]
[b][h2]But that’s not the end of good news!
[/h2][/b]
You can build a star-studded empire in the bustling city of Los Ricos with support for multiple languages including [b]EN, ES, PL, RU, CN, NL, DE, and FR.[/b] 

It doesn’t mean that we won’t present more languages in the future though.*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/2769c05462fbdd81a2f4ed30d6df4115b520dedd.png[/img]
[b][h2]PLAYTESTERS NEEDED![/h2][/b]
Blockbuster Inc. is made by a studio of 3, so even with our best efforts, we don’t speak so many languages! As we presented the new localization versions, we could really use your help in playtesting. 

If you are a native speaker of one of the languages presented (EN, ES, PL, RU, CN, NL, DE, and FR) and you are available to help us test it out, feel free to contact us at [b]blockbuster@ancientforgestudio.com[/b]. We will be happy to work with you to make our localization as smooth and enjoyable as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/6dc18d40268dc8d6cd2cfb8d34c1b77c4c085a82.png[/img]
[i]*With the release, we will present a roadmap of our post-launch support plan including lots of content and features. If you want to see your language there, let us know in the comments![/i]

notes.title: Lights, Camera, Collaboration: Meet Our Publisher
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/8bc2f925ea17781928a3582e10a0f40ab638458d.png[/img]

Developer Super Sly Fox and publisher Ancient Forge with the help of Games Operators, are proud to announce their collaboration on bringing Blockbuster Inc. to the PC market. Recognizing the similarities between their games, the philosophy behind their design, and the creative opportunities it presented, [b]Super Fly Fox and Ancient Forge eagerly agreed to join forces[/b] on this exciting project.

To celebrate the occasion, we have updated the store page with a new trailer video and a number of juicy screenshots. Make sure to check it all out!

[previewyoutube=JT2gTTsxGI8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]"We instantly fell in love with both the idea and execution behind Super Sly Fox's debut title, and we decided to support the whole endeavor with our whole hearts. I've had a personal longing for The Movies' spiritual successor, Blockbuster Inc. came out of nowhere and will scratch that 'I wanna make a movie' itch."[/i] [b]said Dushan Chaciej, Co-Founder of Ancient Forge[/b].

[b]Panos Tzimas, founder of Super Sly Fox,[/b] noted the following: [I]"We could not be happier to collaborate with Ancient Forge Studio, not only because of their experience in our genre and niche, but mostly because of our alignment on how to reach Blockbuster Inc's full potential. We are already developing things beyond the original scope and will continue to do so, in order to give players an exciting experience that will satisfy their movie simulation game needs."[/i]

[h3]What does this mean for you, the Blockbuster Inc. community?[/h3]
With the support and resources provided by Ancient Forge, our dedicated developers can now focus entirely on refining and expanding the game, ensuring that it meets the high-quality standards that this incredible title deserves. As we work together, we'll be able to [b]deliver a more polished and feature-rich experience[/b], which will only enhance the enjoyment of Blockbuster Inc. for our players. Moreover, this partnership creates new opportunities for community engagement, allowing us to better understand your needs and expectations while fostering an active, enthusiastic, and supportive gaming environment for all Blockbuster Inc. fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/0a800e911a710ba8208e9e23ce76f60404522aa1.png[/img]

As a token of our excitement and appreciation, we are thrilled to announce that we will be [b]releasing a demo of Blockbuster Inc. during the upcoming Steam Festival in June![/b] This demo will give players a taste of what's to come and showcase the fantastic potential of this collaboration.

Thank you for your unwavering support, and stay tuned for more information about Blockbuster Inc.!

notes.title: Blockbuster Inc. November update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I want to say a big thank you for being so patient lately, I know we have been silent for a few months and there was speculation that production stopped, but we can assure you it was the opposite of that. We cannot yet announce some big news but we can show you a summarized version (for now) of what is new in the game.

[olist]
[*] Improved graphics in both areas of the game ( studio lot and city map )
[*] Implemented our next big feature called Set Designer where players get to customize and upload/download their sets on Steam Workshop
[*] Currently working on adding even more content to the game and gameplay parts like managing employees, managing teams, finances, bank loans and actions such as educating employees and negotiating deals with rival studios.
[*] Implemented a basic production cycle that now works, we will be polishing it further as we progress with more features that affect movies and tv shows.
[/olist]

Last but not least, if you are curious about seeing some of these changes and how the game is looking right now (minus some polishing that happened after we made the new trailer), do check our updated steam page where you can see new screenshots and the new trailer here:

notes.title: New additions and overall improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have really been quiet but at the same time hard working on some new features of the game and overall polish. We are completing our core loop and expanding some ideas that we would like to share with you in time. So without further ado let us see what has changed since our last post a few months ago.

[h1]1) City Map[/h1]
We added a city map where the players will be able to rent flats for their more famous Stars. Depending on their fame level, they will require a better area ( 5 of them ). You can see visually the quality of the areas changing as well as some nice details such as a fictional version of the walk of fame.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/1668ca058831e2fb783f3e789e7c106e8eab03a6.png[/img]


[h1]2) Improved Studio Lot and Modular Characters[/h1]
We felt the need to add more substance and a better atmosphere to the studio lot where the main gameplay happens, as well as improve the existing people by giving them body shapes that change depending on their traits and events.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/b6ce09dffd4488508aac7f1a2edb17fbc485a31b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/f2d982a6189f2acf3ce91fb09f133f7b4fb4cc36.png[/img]

The Filmwood prominent sign is a major attraction on the city of Los Ricos, that is where most of your competitors will be located as well.

We refined the roles and icons of the employees as well, you can see the new ones on the bottom.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/f25daaa7915344431f83c45b7ec58218b43aab66.png[/img]


[h1]4) Improved and almost finished the product creation[/h1]
We have been working on the core gameplay a lot and made improvements and added a lot of animations that help strenghten the immersion of the current build. Here is a filming phase occuring in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41404433/058f99442402c78d36b7d77d8c1aa4eff314fe20.png[/img]



Finally if you have missed our previous build mode walkthrough you can check it out here:
[previewyoutube=LDmJ-c0dtUw;full][/previewyoutube]


We are constantly adding and polishing things, heading fast towards our demo and then aiming for the Early Access build. If you want to contact us and tell us ideas and generally your thoughts about our project you can find us on Discord here:

notes.title: Devlog #1 Construction System
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! 

It has been a bit over a month since you last heard from us, we are making great progress on all ends and we are ready to sharehere our first devlog on youtube. 

[previewyoutube=LDmJ-c0dtUw;full][/previewyoutube]

In the video we overview our current available tools and their functionalities. Those include: 

[olist]
[*] Selection tool which is used for to select rooms and drag the walls to change their shape and room size
[*] The eyedropper tool which is used to copy the materials of walls or floors
[*] Undo and redo steps without a limit currently
[*] Bulldozer tool which destroys the whole lot
[*] Bludgeon tool which destroys specific walls or is used as a selection/destruction tool
[*] Wall and Room building tools
[*] A clone tool that can clone whole buildings with all the objects without performance issues

All the tools have extra functionalities which give you, the players, the abilities to create fast and meaningful changes to your studio lot faster such as painting the walls of whole buildings in a matter of seconds by just holding shift, marquee selections on multiple tools when you click and drag, visual indication of errors or misplaced objects that cannot function is specific slots. 

[/olist]


[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[olist]
[*]  Add room viewer window 
[*]  Add room selection functionality
[*]  Add room assignment features for employees (Code & UI)
[*]  Improve employee behavior when trapped or stuck in objects/walls
[*]  Fix door animations
[*]  Tool functionality bugfixes + polishing
[*]  New visuals for in-progress objects
[*]  Add UI screenshot generation of employees
[*]  Add code support for pawn visuals: Weight + Build
[*]  Fix aspect ratio lock & improve other windows related behavior
[/olist]

If you want to stay up to date and talk to us directly, please consider joining our new discord group, we would appreciate hearing from you!
